title: SE implementation scratchpad - Granite Federal
content:
Context:
- Customer: Granite Federal (regional bank, heavy compliance). POC for private deployment (VPC) + Dedicated reserved capacity for peak hours.
- Primary goals: data isolation, KMS integration, predictable latency under 200ms p99 for short prompts, and audit logs for transactions.

Meeting notes (2025-09-18):
- Kickoff w/ IT (Mark, Lila) + security (Anil). They will provide VPC CIDR and peering contact by Fri 9/19.
- Compliance asked for KMS key rotation policy and HSM options. Need to confirm supported providers (AWS KMS / CloudHSM) + integration steps.
- SLA: they expect 99.9% uptime and <250ms p95 during business hours; propose Dedicated pool with autoscale + burst capacity.

Top-level TODOs (priority order):
- [ ] Get VPC CIDR and peering contact (owner: Mark) — due 9/19 (pending)
- [ ] Share draft network diagram + public IP whitelist/ports (owner: Priya) — due 9/20
- [ ] Confirm KMS provider & exportable key policy (owner: Ethan) — due 9/22
- [ ] Provide latency test plan + synthetic load script (owner: Maya) — due 9/23
- [ ] Draft rollback policy for model/rollout (owner: Priya) — due 9/24

Network / infra notes (initial):
- They prefer AWS GovCloud-style isolation but currently on standard AWS account. VPC CIDR requested.
- Proposed peering: VPC peering vs Transit Gateway? Recommend TGW for many accounts; start with VPC peering for PoC to reduce complexity.
- Required ports: 443 (api), 2200 (ssh bastion), 9300-9400 (intra-node comms) — confirm with infra.
- NAT + egress: allow only to Redwood control plane IP ranges (provide list) and to S3 endpoints for model artifacts.

Private deployment config (POC):
- Model: open-instruct-13b quantized (customer wants 13B for accuracy; will test with 7B fallback).
- Runtime: dedicated pool with min_replicas: 2, max_replicas: 6, cpu_probe_threshold: 70%
- Autoscale policy: scale-up based on token throughput + queue latency > 100ms for 30s window.
- Batching: target batch size 8 for average prompt length ~120 tokens; tune after initial traffic injection.
- KV cache: enable prefix caching for common prompts, TTL 24h for session affinity; measure cache hit rate.

Auth / encryption notes:
- KMS: customer will use AWS KMS (alias/granite-secrets). Need to provide steps for Redwood to request decrypt permissions + IAM role ARN they will grant.
- Admin access: require RBAC mapping to their SSO (Okta) — list of IdP groups required for SRE/Product to grant: se-admins, se-ops.
- Audit logs: retention 1 year. Confirm format (JSON events) and delivery (S3 bucket vs forwarded syslog).

Rollout plan (canary -> full):
- Stage 0: internal smoke on staging (2 pods) — run synthetics, perf regression tests.
- Stage 1: Canary (5% traffic) to POC cluster, monitor latency, error rate, mem/cpu, and output quality via eval prompts. 24h observation.
- Stage 2: 25% traffic for 48h with autoscaling enabled. If quality regressions, auto-fallback to quantized-7b variant.
- Stage 3: 100% migration, enable auditing and retention policies.
- Rollback: immediate route to fallback variant + scale up fallback to match required throughput.

Quality / eval notes:
- Provide seed prompt set (billing/customer-service/reg-acct) — need 200 representative prompts from GF.
- Baseline metrics: token length distribution, avg latency, hallucination rate (manual eval initially).
- Add regression alarms: output-change-rate > 5% vs baseline for critical prompts.

CLI / config snippets (POC) — copy to their infra team:
- sample config (pseudo):
  deployment_name: granite-fed-poc
  model: redwood/open-instruct-13b-quantized
  dedicated_pool:
    min_replicas: 2
    max_replicas: 6
    instance_type: p4d-like
  autoscale:
    metric: token_throughput
    scale_up_threshold: 1000
    scale_down_threshold: 200
  network:
    allowed_cidrs: [REPLACE_WITH_GF_CIDR]
    control_plane_whitelist: [REPLACE_WITH_REDWOOD_IPS]

Notes to self (quick):
- Bring up a tiny perf cluster tomorrow and run loadgen from their office region to measure RTT.
- Prepare short doc on KMS perms: need decrypt, generate-data-key, describe-key for service account.
- Check legal: do we need addendum for log retention > 365d? loop in contracts.

Open questions (to chase):
- Can they accept occasional model fallbacks to quantized variant for cost reasons? Pricing conversation needed.
- Confirm whether audit logs must be encrypted with customer KMS or Redwood-managed.
- Confirm expected peak QPS and typical business-hour window (their estimate provided is vague).

Meeting prep for 9/24 (follow-up with security):
- Bring 1-page KMS integration notes + IAM role template.
- Bring network diagram and proposed peering steps (minimal downtime).
- Bring canary plan and rollback checklist.

Quick links / references:
- CONF-Granite-Fed-Design (internal)
- JIRA-GF-4123 (customer feature request, priority P1)
- PR#3426 (infra: add TGW support for GF)

Final quick checklist before POC sign-off:
- [ ] VPC peering established and connectivity test OK
- [ ] KMS access validated with a test encrypt/decrypt flow
- [ ] Load test shows p95 < 250ms under target workload
- [ ] Audit log delivery confirmed and retention set
- [ ] Legal sign-off on retention + SLA

Notes to self: keep this doc as running scratchpad; will clean up and move content to CONF page after POC stable.

-- Priya
